picks.headline: 'Lion King' Director Rob Minkoff Joins AI-Assisted Film 'Storm Dogs' From Tilly Norwood Creator Particle 6
picks.excerpt: Rob Minkoff, the co-director of “The Lion King,” is in advanced discussions to board the AI-assisted film “Storm Dogs” from Particle 6.
picks.rationale: A major studio animation director is signing on to an AI-assisted feature. That makes this the clearest sign yet that established filmmakers are moving into AI production.

picks.headline: Turkish Distributor Baska Sinema Boards AI-Generated Feature 'A Woman Asleep' for Theatrical Release
picks.excerpt: Turkish distributor Baska Sinema boards AI-generated feature 'A Woman Asleep' for theatrical release
picks.rationale: A fully AI-generated feature has landed a theatrical distributor. That opens a real release path for AI-made films outside festivals and streaming.
